Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: Swiggy's category tabs - a row of claymorphic category icons under the header where switching tabs retints the whole page theme (blue -> pink), re-themes the search hint, and cross-loads content behind a brief branded spinner.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
The Swiggy home: orange header block (Bellandur location row, profile icon), a search bar whose placeholder cycles ("Search for 'Soogi'", "'Coffee'", "'Bottles'", "'Shower Gel'", "'Smartwatch'"), a horizontal tab row of 3D clay icons (All, Fresh, Grocery, Electronics, Home, Beauty, Kids), and content below - hero banner ("ULTIMATE BINGE FEST", "Freshest Seasonal Fruits!", "Stay Warm, Sip Happy!", "Winter Skincare For Babies!") plus category tiles.

## Motion spec
Pattern: theme-morphing tab switch.
- Tap a tab: the selected clay icon pops (scale 1 -> 1.12 -> 1, spring ~450/20) and the tab row's active pill slides under it (spring ~420/24, 250ms).
- The entire header + background crossfades to the category's theme color (300ms) - blue for All, pink for Grocery - including the search bar tint.
- The search placeholder text swaps with a vertical roll (old text rolls up, new rolls in, 250ms).
- Content below transitions through a loading state: old content fades out (150ms), a small orange Swiggy "C"-spinner rotates once in the center (400ms), then the new banner and tiles stagger in top-down (80ms per row, fade + translateY 12pt -> 0).
- The clay icons themselves are glossy renders with highlight shine - they get a subtle idle wobble when their tab is active.

## Calibration
- The theme color change is the loudest signal - keep it fast (300ms) so repeated tabbing feels instant.
- The spinner shows only if content isn't ready within 100ms - no flashing it on fast switches.

## Reduced motion
Theme crossfades without motion; content fades in without stagger; icons don't pop.

## Don't miss
- The clay icon style: puffy 3D renders with soft shadows, not flat glyphs.
- The hero banner crossfades with a slight horizontal parallax slide as tabs change.
